exposure: adalimumab treatment in pregnant women with inflammatory arthropathies (IA)
outcome: mode of birth (Cesarean section, natural method)
cohort: The study included 30 pregnant patients with inflammatory arthropathies (PsA, RA, IBD, AS, uveitis, Behcet's disease, panuveitis) receiving adalimumab, whose medical files were reviewed.
finding: The study reported delivery outcomes in 10% of cases (2 abortions, 1 preterm complication) and neonatal IUGR in 6.7% of cases, with no other neonatal complications found for 93.3% of cases; however, definitive conclusions on adalimumab safety were not possible due to the small sample size.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the delivery method in 23.3% of cases and natural method in 70%, with no significant differences in the prevalence of cesarean section based on the type of disease.
